title: Vita Mahjong Pairs
description: Relax with crisp oversized Mahjong tiles inspired by the global Vita Mahjong phenomenon—pair matching free tiles cleanly across layered boards to clear every handcrafted layout.
controls: Tap two identical uncovered Mahjong tiles with at least one open side to match and clear them from the board.

zh-CN.title: 麻将对对碰 Vita
zh-CN.description: 海外长青榜霸榜神作 Vita 大字麻将对对碰：清晰大牌面一眼看清，轻松配对消除多层国风麻将牌局，老少皆宜超解压！
zh-CN.controls: 点击两张相同且未被左右夹住或遮挡的大号麻将牌即可配对消除，清空整盘牌面通关。
